input: L2-normalised KD768 embedding (768-d). z = emb / max(norm(emb), 1e-12)
score: softmax(w_folded @ z + b_folded); StandardScaler already folded into w_folded/b_folded. Do NOT also apply scaler_mean/scaler_scale if using w_folded.

label_map.Severe: ICDR 3 Severe NPDR + ICDR 4 Proliferative DR

threshold_note: No extra decision threshold — use argmax over the 4-class softmax. colours[pred] is the UI colour.
